after.statement_or_definition: Input exact M×D isometry V with 1≤D≤M and explicit ordered bases, in ideal arithmetic with exact zero tests. Initialize list with its D columns. For each standard vector e_j, subtract its projections onto the current orthonormal list; if residual norm is zero skip, otherwise normalize and append. Stop when M vectors are present; return the unitary W with this list as columns, so its first D columns equal V. For qubit widths use the embedding of |x> tensor |0^a> as the declared first D input columns via an explicit basis permutation.
